The Natural Language Generation module translates the action decision from the Dialog Policy module to natural language, e.g. request(brand) → Do you have a brand in mind?. In this paper we simply use manually written agent templates.
The NLG module transforms the response into natural language displayed to user.
outputs: System responses (natural language utterances) generated by the NLG module

We use the success rate (SR@t) to measure the ratio of successful conversations, i.e. recommended the ground-truth item in t turns.
